May your year be filled with clear skies, smooth landings, and many new destinations.''' @sal_Label: $'''Salutaion: *''' @sal_Value: $'''Cheers to you,''' @from_Label: $'''From: *''' @from_Value: $'''ACP ATL Luke Grout'''

WebAutomation.Click.Click BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... ?pageid=84\'']['Input text \'ctl01$eThx_TxtSearchEmployeeName\''] ClickType: WebAutomation.ClickType.LeftClick MouseClick: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60 MousePositionRelativeToElement: WebAutomation.RectangleEdgePoint.MiddleCenter OffsetX: 0 OffsetY: 0
LOOP FOREACH bDayInfo IN bdayTable
    IF Contains(bDayInfo[4], $'''ER7''', False) THEN
        # Send to ERJ Pilot
        WebAutomation.SelectRadioButton.SelectRadioButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... ?pageid=84\'']['Input radio \'ctl01$cardList$ctrl4$CardGroup\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
    ELSE
        # Send to CRJ Pilot
        WebAutomation.SelectRadioButton.SelectRadioButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... ?pageid=84\'']['Input radio \'ctl01$cardList$ctrl3$CardGroup\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
    END
    # Parse Name
    Text.SplitText.SplitWithDelimiter Text: bDayInfo[2] CustomDelimiter: $''',''' IsRegEx: False Result=> nameList
    Text.Trim Text: nameList[1] TrimOption: Text.TrimOption.Both TrimmedText=> firstName
    /# inject text
#/
    WebAutomation.ExecuteJavascript BrowserInstance: Browser Javascript: $'''function ExecuteScript() {
// Set name
document.getElementById(\"eThx_TxtSearchEmployeeName\").value = \"%bDayInfo[1]%\";
document.getElementById(\"eThx_TxtSearchEmployeeName\").dispatchEvent(new Event(\'change\', { bubbles: true }));

// Set date
// Get original birthday from PAD
var originalDate = \"%bDayInfo[3]%\"; // e.g., \"06/25/1990\"

// Split into parts
var parts = originalDate.split(\"/\");
var month = parts[0];
var day = parts[1];

// Get current year
// var currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();


 // Use target year 2026 (fixed)
  var targetYear = 2026;


// Rebuild date string
// var thisYearBirthday = month + \"/\" + day + \"/\" + currentYear;
//document.getElementById(\"mTxtSendDate\").value = thisYearBirthday;
var targetBirthday = month + \"/\" + day + \"/\" + targetYear;
document.getElementById(\"mTxtSendDate\").value = targetBirthday;
document.getElementById(\"mTxtSendDate\").dispatchEvent(new Event(\'change\', { bubbles: true }));

// Set subject
document.getElementById(\"txtSubject\").value = \"Happy Birthday!\";
document.getElementById(\"txtSubject\").dispatchEvent(new Event(\'change\', { bubbles: true }));

// Construct and set note
var noteText = \"%firstName%,\\n\\n\" +
               \"%eTHX['note']%\"+ \"\\n\\n\" +
               \"%eTHX['sal']%\" + \"\\n\" +
               \"%eTHX['from']%\";

document.getElementById(\"txtNote\").value = noteText;
document.getElementById(\"txtNote\").dispatchEvent(new Event(\'change\', { bubbles: true }));
}''' Result=> Result
    WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... ?pageid=84\'']['Input image \'ctl01$btnSend\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60

    WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... ?pageid=84\'']['Image'])
END
